nodes.label: Weekly Report Email
nodes.rationale: Compact analytics digest email (stat tiles for Visits/Users/Contributions/Pending, 4-week average deltas, Country pulse and Contribution breakdown bar charts, Pending review queue card). Localhost traffic is excluded by querying only maps.karamahcollective.com; the 4-week average uses the four weeks before the report window; real email uses inline styles for client compatibility.
